decision_lens: Prioritize findings where the combinatorial space is shallower than it appears or where unique properties are so rare they never appear in normal play.
focus: Whether the Diablo-style art generation pipeline produces sufficient combinatorial richness and narrative density
name: fd-procedural-art-depth
persona: An expert in procedural content generation with experience in loot systems (ARPG, roguelikes) and narrative-flavored procedural text. Evaluates whether the pipeline produces artifacts that feel hand-crafted despite being generated.
review_areas: Count the actual combinatorial space: genre families × base types × prefix pools × suffix pools × unique properties — does it support no two compositions are the same across 40 days?
Evaluate the genre selection probability formula — does Classical dominate in most settlements?
Check Magnum Opus conditions (skill 10 + inspiration > 90 + mood > 50) — realistic probability?
Assess compound state coverage: how many compound states does a typical elf enter per session?
Verify unique property conditions against behavior tree — can Charged realistically occur?
Evaluate whether mastery, originality, emotional are truly independent or implicitly correlated
success_hints: A named composition should carry enough info to reconstruct the elf's state at creation time
Unique properties should appear in roughly 1-in-4 compositions during active play
All three genre families should be represented across a 20-elf settlement over 40 days
task_context: Art is generated like Diablo loot: base type + mood prefix + inspiration suffix + rare unique properties across 3 genre families.
